subject: Catalyst Health — request for AWS co-sell warm bridge & joint account plan

Subject: Catalyst Health — request for AWS co-sell warm bridge & joint account plan

Team — quick ask. We have a promising inbound from Catalyst Health (contact: Alex Reynolds). They’re evaluating multi-region inference and want to understand integration, cost profile, and a co-sell path with AWS. Request: can we coordinate a warm bridge with AWS (Sara Chen) and run a short joint-account planning call next week to align roles, timelines, and procurement runway?

Why now: Catalyst is on a Q3 rollout and procurement has AWS marketplace preference — this is an ideal co-sell candidate.

Suggested owners: Karthik to lead discovery + demo; Vivek to join on the first exec alignment if we need negotiation support. I attached a preliminary MAP template to capture next steps and stakeholders.

Attachments: Redwood_prelim_MAP_template.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)

Next steps: 
- Karthik: can you take point on scheduling?
- Vivek: can you confirm exec availability for a 30–45m alignment next Wed/Thu afternoon PT?

Thanks — Kimberly

--

I’ll also prepare a short 10-min technical scope (latency/cost expectations + integration checklist) and share the Redwood demo deck draft. Attaching my draft deck.

Thanks Karthik/Kimberly — we’re excited to learn more. Wed 7/7 3:00pm PT works for Alex + Maya (we’re East coast). Please include our security lead (cc’d) — they’ll want a short pre-read on data flows and retention.

A couple of things to flag from our side:
- Procurement preference: Marketplace purchase if the commercial terms align.
- Compliance: SOC2 & data residency will be gating for phase 1.
- Tech: expected token throughput target ~ 18k tokens/min during peak test.

We’ll expect a short agenda and an early visibility to MAP + any pre-reqs.

Best,
Alex

Thanks for the intro — Sara here (AWS GTM, AI/ML Co-sell). Happy to join the warm bridge. I can cover marketplace listing/contract routing and options for customer private offers.

Suggested agenda for 7/7 3:00pm PT (30–40m):
1) Intros & success criteria (5m)
2) Catalyst current architecture + perf targets (8m)
3) Redwood demo + integration plan (10m)
4) Marketplace procurement path & timelines (7m)
5) Security gating & next steps (5m)

Pre-reads: please share the MAP doc and a one-page security summary. I’ll bring the AWS marketplace checklist and a sample private-offer timeline.

Quick note: if you want a sponsor from the AWS account team, I can loop John Patel — let me know.
